verdict.rationale: ROS 2 provides its own building-block features that bear on this story. QoS settings are documented as being for non-ideal networks, and reliability can be tuned from TCP-like to UDP-like. Transient-local durability makes the publisher persist samples for late-joining subscribers, and rosbag plus its Python API can record data to local bags while the robot keeps processing. However, nothing documents behavior during a cloud outage, store-and-forward upload, or how the system recovers once the link returns. missing for 10: documented cloud-disconnect operation, store-and-forward sync to cloud on reconnect, clean recovery semantics, hands-on corroboration of offline resilience
